homepageTopArticles.title: Google unveils its new Universal Cart for agentic commerce
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Google kicked off its annual Google I/O developer conference on May 19 with numerous announcements, including new details about its latest agentic commerce and checkout tool, the Universal Cart. Universal Cart is built on top of Google’s Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), which enables artificial intelligence (AI) agents to communicate with payments infrastructure in ecommerce transactions. This innovation aims to advance agentic commerce by streamlining transactions.

homepageTopArticles.title: Google’s new Universal Cart wants to follow your entire shopping journey across the internet
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Most people shop across multiple devices, many retailers, and over the course of many days, which is why Google is launching Universal Cart.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: AI-generated summary: Google is launching Universal Cart to track and unify shoppers' purchases across multiple devices and retailers over extended periods, addressing the fragmented nature of modern online shopping.

homepageTopArticles.snippet: If your pricing hasn't changed since gold was $3,000, it's not just outdated — it's actively eroding your margins job by job.
